title: 🔊 Let's pronounce: the plural s and the letter y ⭐

questions.prompt: Say these words in your head. Which word ends with the buzzing sound /z/?
questions.explanation: The word pen ends with n, a sound that shakes the throat, so the s of pens buzzes: /z/. Hat ends with t and cup and map end with p, quiet sounds, so the s of those words hisses: /s/, even though the letter is the same.

questions.prompt: Only one of these words ends with the hissing sound /s/. Which one?
questions.explanation: The word sock ends with k, a quiet sound, so the s of socks hisses: /s/. Bird ends with d, doll with l and egg with g, sounds that shake the throat, so the s of those words buzzes: /z/.

questions.prompt: Which word has the same last sound as "fly"?
questions.explanation: Cry is a short word, and the y at the end of a short word says /ai/, like fly and try. Happy and windy are long words, so their y says /i/, and key ends with the long sound of ee, which is not /ai/ either.

questions.prompt: Which word ends like "sunny", with the short sound /i/?
questions.explanation: Baby is a long word, and the y at the end of a long word says /i/, like sunny and family. Why and shy are short words and say /ai/, and July is the one long word of the unit that also says /ai/.
